component.name: RPC Buddy
component.summary: Show what you play and listen to as Discord Rich Presence

description.p: RPC Buddy shows the Steam game you are playing as your Discord activity — with the game's official name and artwork — even when Discord runs as a Flatpak and cannot detect games itself.
It also shows the music you listen to in players such as Deezer or TIDAL, including music websites in your browser.
